$comment: What every snowcat-cockpit worker image guarantees on PATH (ADR-0012 §1). A repository declares anything beyond this in its mise.toml/mise.lock (core ADR-0043). Versions here are the image's pins; Debian packages come from the pinned golang:bookworm base digest. Bump alongside oci/Containerfile.

stopgap.$comment: Leaves the base once every enrolled repository pins it in mise.lock (Snowcat rollout plan, Phase 6).

environment.GOPATH: /tmp/go (exec tmpfs; the home tmpfs is noexec under Docker)
environment.PATH: /var/lib/snowcat-cockpit/mise/shims first, then the image binaries; also set by /etc/profile.d/snowcat-cockpit-mise.sh for login shells
